name: i2c_twoboards_comit
description: I2C_TwoBoards_ComIT on two NUCLEO-F446RE wired as its readme draws them (two_boards.json): as ComPolling, by interrupts (HAL_I2C_*_IT): I2C1 at 400 kHz, the slave's 10-bit address 0x30F, B1's USER button starting each step. The master sends its 147-byte buffer (SCL clocks 149 bytes: 2684 edges with START and STOP), then reads it back (150 bytes with the repeated START: 2704 edges). Both boards' buffers then hold the text and LD2 stays on on both.
